verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an orchestration framework, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The only MCP evidence is client-side: MCPAdapter lets agents call tools on other MCP servers. The Agent Server is described only as exposing run, thread and assistant API endpoints, with no MCP endpoint mentioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
